WEBSITE INFORMATION

Website privacy

This marketing website provides information about Smartup programmes and centres. It does not create student accounts, take payments, or collect enquiry details through an on-site form.

When you contact us

Calling or emailing Smartup uses your phone or email service. Share only the information needed for your enquiry. For students under 18, a parent or guardian should handle admissions enquiries.

External services

Directions and social media links open external services with their own privacy policies. Fonts and client images are hosted with the site. Video thumbnails are requested from YouTube. When you press play, an embedded YouTube player connects to YouTube and is subject to Google’s privacy policy. App Store and Google Play links open the respective app stores. This website does not use advertising trackers or analytics cookies. The hosting provider may process technical request information to serve and secure the website.

Questions about your information

Contact Smartup at info@smartupedu.in or +91 88919 10919 for privacy questions or requests relating to information you have shared with the team.

Student app and learning platform policies are separate from this marketing website.
